# f5xc_user_identification (Resource)

user identification object A user_identification object consists of an ordered list of rules. The rules are evaluated against the input fields that are extracted from an request API to determine a user identifier. The identifier is subsequently used to apply a rate_limiter to the request. A user_identification object can be referred to from virtual_host and rate_limiter objects. The rules in the most specific user_identification object are used to obtain the identifier prior to applying a rate_limiter. For example, the user_identification rules from a rate_limiter are preferred over those from a virtual_host. If there no user_identification objects associated with the virtual_host or the rate_limiter being applied, the client IP address is treated as the identifier.

To get more information about f5xc_user_identification, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/user-identification)
